Among them, a particular incident in the Lin Clan resulted in the banishment of a certain individual who went on to start his own family, in hopes of one day being recognized again by the Lin Clan, and rejoining them…
Hailing from a banished family of the Great Lin Clan, when Lin Dong was very young, he watched, powerless, as his talented father was easily crushed and crippled by the overwhelming genius of the great Lin Clan, Lin Langtian.
With a despairing father, a heartbroken grandfather, and a suffering family, ever since that fateful day, Lin Dong has been driven by a deep purpose; to take revenge on the man who had taken everything and more from his family.

99400.synopsis:

Now left enduring his half-brother’s smugness, Xie Qiaoyu sets out once again in search of a dependable scholar… and unexpectedly finds himself drawn to a fallen noble, a so-called “good-for-nothing.”
At first, he mocks the declining Wan family, “Serves the Wan family right.”
Until he meets Wan Mingji—unkempt yet handsome, dressed in mourning attire.
“Mourning clothes make the man,” and Xie Qiaoyu’s heart skips a beat.
Quietly, he starts approaching Wan Mingji and asks, “Do you have any plans to sit for the imperial exam?”
After all, even a scoundrel could earn a degree under his supervision.
Wan Mingji, “No.”
Xie Qiaoyu, ”…No wonder you’re single.”
If he weren’t just a concubine’s son, with his looks alone, many would’ve lined up to marry him in this town. But alas—he is just a concubine’s son.
Now that he’s running around with a broke scoundrel, everyone mocks him.
And then… they all get slapped in the face.
—
Wan Mingji, once a dashing young talent, returned home after his studies to find his family in ruins and his name disgraced. Everyone avoided him. When he saw the now-grown, stunningly beautiful Xie Qiaoyu, he thought nothing of it—he was a straight man, with zero interest in pretty boys.
Xie Qiaoyu kept helping him anyway. Wan Mingji figured maybe they could just be “brothers.”
Wan Mingji, sincerely, “Let’s be brothers.”
Xie Qiaoyu, silently.
I want you to be my husband, and you call me your brother? Who treats a ge’er like their brother?! I’m going to kill you.
Xie Qiaoyu, grinding his teeth, “You’re going to die alone.”
Until one day, Wan Mingji sees a dirt-smudged Xie Qiaoyu up close, noses almost touching…
Next thing he knows, he’s standing at the gates of the Xie family home—to propose marriage.
Later, with fingers laced together, Wan Mingji asks his subordinates, “Family members can accompany soldiers, right?”
—
Even after marriage, Xie Qiaoyu remains hopelessly vain. He gets envious easily when others seem to be doing better than him—but just thinking of his husband makes it all sweet again.
“Wan Mingji, I want to eat a tiger!”
The next day, sure enough, he eats a tiger.

 Host detected.

⌈ Host, based on your family background and overall abilities, the system recommends choosing the entertainment industry as your career path. ⌋
⌈ According to your physical report from your previous life, this career path carries high risk and offers low energy gains for you. ⌋

 “And who said figure skating can’t make you world-famous?” 
From national competitions to the World Championships, and then to the Olympic stage.
 From falling flat on the ice again and again to executing smooth quadruple Axel jumps.

In a barren land, a dried-up spring regained its vitality and began sharing its passion with the world.

The author is not a professional—technical knowledge comes from various platforms. Feel free to point out any mistakes. 
The system’s “cheat” function has minimal presence. 
Growth-focused feel-good story.

Bad news: She is a universally despised female lead, so loathed that readers have petitioned the creator to write her out!

The delicate, beautiful healer lowers her tearful eyes. “So… everyone really hates me.”

King of the Demonic Domain is the hottest shonen manga of the moment.

The upright, stoic male lead; the chaotic, morally gray second male; the noble, self-sacrificing third male…

At first, she’s the saintly fool whose attempt to save a cat traps her team in a beastly crisis, earning her the title of Most Hated Character.
Then, readers uncover her truth: a suppressed madwoman saint, oppressed by the superpower clergy, her kindness twisted into obsession—a witch they can’t help but root for.
And later, jaws drop as she plays them all: unleashing apocalyptic floods, stealing the guarded dragon bones, and delivering calamity with ruthless fairness.
Beneath Ye Zheng’s gentle, holy facade lies unyielding ambition and ferocity.
[Did Ye Zheng show up today? I’m obsessed with this villainous queen!] 
[Zheng-jie, go easy on the protagonists, don’t hurt my fave!] 
[Guys, I’ve switched sides—Ye Zheng is too cool!] 
[Shaking here… who remembers when we thought she was just a healer tool?] 
[I’m out, grabbing merch—this woman’s terrifyingly awesome!] 
Even the system is stunned: “Wake up! You’re supposed to be the gentle, kind shonen heroine!”
Ye Zheng flashes a serene smile. “Who says a villainous queen can’t be the female lead?”
Reading Guide:
– The female lead is a righteous-to-ruthless villain.
– Inspired by the unfair treatment of female characters in some shonen manga.

The Demon Lord, Dongfang Chen, was cold and merciless, a ruthless killer.
The Emotionless Dao’s young immortal was rigid and rule-bound, living like a walking book of sect discipline.
The aloof sword cultivator appeared gentle as jade, yet hid his strength beneath a harmless façade.
And the heir of Medicine King Valley, who looked harmless and innocent, was best at turning poison into sugar and coaxing people into swallowing it…
With her cultivation damaged, Jiang Yan also received an unfortunate “bonus”—face blindness. Awkwardly, she admitted: she couldn’t recognize any of them at all. As for this overwhelming storm of romance? Whoever wanted it could have it. This rich lady only wished to return home quickly and squander her billions in peace.
So, armed with carefully written dissolution contracts, she went to find them—only to discover several miserable “pixelated” beasts lying at her feet in their original forms.
“Hey! I’m here to break the bond, not to raise cute pets!”
To coax the powerful men into taking medicine, transforming back into human form, and dissolving the contracts, she had no choice but to activate full praise mode.

“That lion is the most disobedient one~ Our big flood dragon is the most sensible~”
Then she turned to the Black Flood Dragon Demon Lord,
“Our little snake is the strongest, unlike that big black dragon~”
The little green snake sighed, rubbing his forehead.

Jiang Yan froze.

The husbands exchanged glances and calmly signed… each other’s names—perfectly mismatched on purpose.
Staring at the repeated name “Gongsun Jin,” Jiang Yan suddenly realized what was happening. Did they think a face-blind person was the same as blind?
Turning around, she wrapped her arm around their supposed rival and smiled brightly.
“Husband, shall we cultivate together?”
